name: mcp-memory-service
notes: Authenticated with generated API key. Restrict delete/consolidation tools to explicit user intent.

name: Microsoft Playwright MCP
notes: Use isolated browser state and a pinned reviewed package version; do not mount a personal browser profile by default.

name: Docling MCP
notes: Keep source files and service private; prefer read/convert operations.

name: Filesystem MCP
notes: Usually redundant with Hermes. If enabled, allowlist the narrowest possible directory.

name: Local Git MCP / Git tooling
notes: Separate read-only inspection from write/push authority; scope repositories explicitly.
